intro: The alchemist's notebook was written so that only a fellow adept could read it. Every page is a different recipe, and every recipe is a lie with one true ingredient. The margins are crowded with sigils, but the ink is not alike: some entries are pressed deep, others merely brushed on, and a few seem to sit at the very gate of the page, waiting for a hand to find them. In the back of the book, a single loose sheet lists the names of the five adepts who prepared the vials, each with a number and a letter circled in crimson, as though the order of the cupboard mattered more than the contents. The last line, scratched in haste, reads: the true essence is not in the mixture, but in the place each one occupies.
echo: The goddess of the universal remedy was a daughter of Asclepius.

puzzles.title: Albedo
puzzles.flavor: Everything in the laboratory got thrown in the tumble dryer, and every item came out with a little something extra.
hints: Each jumble is almost a familiar word from this round. Almost.
Rearrange each into a theme word; there's always one letter spare.

puzzles.title: Athanor
puzzles.flavor: Fill the gaps. What you fill them with is the point.
hints: What fills each gap? Is there a pattern in what you filled in?
Collect the letters you had to supply.

puzzles.title: The Green Lion
puzzles.flavor: Somebody shook the sentence and all the letters fell to the bottom of their columns.
hints: The columns say which letters, but not in what order. Can the shape of the grid help?
Start with the short words; a sentence will emerge.

puzzles.title: Rubedo
puzzles.flavor: All the right letters, all in the right words, none in the right places.
hints: Every word here has exactly the right letters. Are they in the right order?
Unscramble the words; the sentence tells you what to submit.

puzzles.title: As Above So Below
puzzles.flavor: Same quantities, many radixes. Convert, then count through the alphabet. Start from the end; that's where it started.

partials.d4d1de8772f7acb90eb35ff347bb6b86bf93a8ca: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: What is the little number telling you about how the big one was written?
Convert each one to ordinary base ten. Whatever you get may still need one more twist.

meta.title: Meta: The Great Work
meta.flavor: Tonight's seating chart. Every seat is one letter wide.
hints: Every entry has two numbers. What in this round is numbered, and what could the second number count?
The first number picks a puzzle; the second picks a letter inside its answer.
